items.raw_excerpt: Labour wants to cut back-to-school costs for families by making school uniforms cheaper and allow for "affordable, generic" alternatives to be used as well.
items.summary_en: Labour wants to make school uniforms cheaper for families. The party would allow affordable, generic options alongside official uniforms.
items.summary_ko: 노동당이 가족들의 교복 부담을 줄이려고 합니다. 공식 교복 대신 저렴한 일반 옷도 허용하겠다는 방침입니다.
items.title_en: Labour Plans to Cut School Uniform Costs
items.title_original: Labour plans to cut school uniform costs and allow 'affordable, generic' options
